title: Memory muscle benchmark v1 validates sediment, promote, bind, reproduce
summary: The memory system must keep a fixed benchmark that checks candidate sediment quality, promotion stability, recall correctness, binding to context, and repeated reproduction of the same top result.

decision.question: How should MetaForge keep a fixed memory-muscle benchmark?
decision.chosen_option: Maintain a benchmark that checks sediment, promote, bind, and reproduce on stable probes.
alternatives_considered: Rely only on ad hoc scorecard probes
Use a fixed benchmark with stage-specific checks and reproduction tests
reasoning: A fixed benchmark makes memory behavior auditable over time.
Four-stage checks cover both memory quality and behavioral habit formation.
Repeated probes are needed to detect drift and cache mismatch.
rollback_condition: If the benchmark becomes stale relative to the memory contract, refresh the fixed probe set.
